acceptanceCriteria: 登记必须核验真实 repository/common directory、WI Contract 存在与 digest、worktree topology、branch/head 和 verification-required 证据；不可信声明 fail closed
SafelyPaused 在恢复前必须拒绝具体执行动作且不得启动进程；无关 WI 继续，恢复后刷新依赖
资源 reserve/release 必须核验当前登记代次，旧执行者不能释放新代次资源
组合身份必须由 Runtime/仓库事实核验，前置条件由 Runtime 计算，必需检查必须完整覆盖，空命令不得成功
组合执行复用既有 bounded executor，逐节点持久化 attempt，真实记录 timeout/interruption/cleanup，stdout/stderr 有执行期上限
CLI/MCP 连续执行证明完全相同输入实际少启动进程，局部变化只重跑受影响节点
影响事件按失效与发布区分，跨代次追加式恢复可解除旧事件阻塞但不删除历史；相关动作前刷新真实 head/Contract/evidence
共享 Outcome 投影反映最近 composition/merge/cleanup/reuse 事实，协调请求不直接伪造 human decision required
真实多进程、多 linked worktree 验收脚本进入 canonical gate manifest 并持续执行
Runtime 前置：本机治理命令解析到公开 Runtime v0.2.113，架构为 aarch64-apple-darwin，archive、SHA256SUMS 和 release-manifest 身份一致；升级前版本保留为可恢复备份。
goal: 让登记、准入、暂停、资源、组合验证、超时恢复、实际复用、影响消费和 Outcome 投影都绑定真实仓库事实并可由 CLI/MCP 与真实多进程验收证明
intent: 修复跨 WI 协作能力从声明模型到真实执行路径的闭环缺口
outOfScope: 不发布、不打 tag、不升级固定 Runtime 0.2.105、不修改全局 Agent/MCP 配置、不引入外部 Provider 资源
不把 Runtime v0.2.113 的安装实现并入产品源码；不发布、不打 tag、不修改 Provider 资源；旧的 0.2.105 固定条款仅作为升级前历史基线保留。

scenarioCoverage.expected: A registration whose repository, common directory, Contract digest, worktree topology, branch, head, or required evidence does not match observed facts is rejected before persistence.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Use real linked worktrees and tamper each identity dimension; assert no registration is persisted and the failure identifies the mismatched fact.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A SafelyPaused target rejects the requested action before process spawn, while an unrelated Work Item remains allowed.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Request and acknowledge safe pause, call the concrete composition action with a process sentinel, and assert sentinel absence plus unrelated admission.

scenarioCoverage.expected: An old-generation owner cannot release a reservation after the Work Item registration advances to a new generation.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Reserve at generation one, register generation two, attempt old release, and assert the reservation remains until a current-generation release.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Composition fails closed when no commands or when declared required checks are not completely covered, regardless of caller-supplied satisfied booleans.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run empty, missing-node, and forged-precondition inputs through the admitted composition entry point and assert zero project processes.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Each node records bounded output, timeout or interruption, and explicit cleanup result durably before the next node or terminal return.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run a sleeping command and terminate the parent execution at a node boundary; inspect append-only attempt records and worktree cleanup status.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Repeated identical CLI and MCP composition calls reuse prior successful nodes without spawning, while a local identity change reruns only affected nodes.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Execute the same request twice and then mutate one node identity; compare persisted per-node process counts and reuse decisions.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Published outcome is not an invalidation event, while an older-generation invalidation can be resolved by a current-generation append-only recovery relation.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Publish both event kinds, advance provider generation, append current recovery, and assert history remains plus consumer admission is restored.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Read-only shared Outcome projection reports the latest identity-bound composition, merge, cleanup, and reuse observations without inventing human authority.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Record shared coordination/composition facts through explicit write entry points and compare CLI/MCP Outcome projections.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The real multi-process linked-worktree acceptance script is a required canonical repository gate.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inspect the manifest dependency closure and run the exact gate command on the final route.

scope: 仅修改跨 WI 协作协议、CoordinationStore、协作准入与恢复、Composition 执行接线、共享 Outcome 投影、CLI/MCP 入口、验收测试、canonical gate manifest 和三语文档
补充本 Work Item 的纠偏 spec 与实现计划，并在发布前形成可独立审查的实现与验证证据
本 Work Item 后续 Runtime 治理命令使用本机外部安装的最新公开 immutable Runtime v0.2.113；Runtime 升级作为独立、可回滚的本地治理前置动作。
Runtime v0.2.113 负责生命周期、准入和证据登记；当前 Work Item 候选源码仍由 Cargo/CI canonical gate 验证，二者保持身份分离。
